text:
Official guideline: ../SGBTGC 2026 - IHL Updates 18 Aug 2026.pdf, pp. 16–18 (18 August 2026 update).
5-minute core presentation. Planned speaking time: 40 seconds.
Presenter cue: Walk through the four layers. Emphasize that perception supports a confirmed request. The controller repeats safety checks during movement and verifies deployed and stowed positions.
Primary source: ../SG_GoAssist_Prototype_Action_Plan.pdf, pp. 3, 9; docs/grand-challenge-integrated-prototype.md, Safety policy; docs/task-requirements-traceability.md. Software logic exists, but physical integration acceptance remains incomplete. VL53L0X threshold calibration, range/status contract adaptation and controller fault tests remain pending. Sensor specification: STMicroelectronics VL53L0X product page https://www.st.com/en/imaging-and-photonics-solutions/vl53l0x.html and DS11555 Rev 6 https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/vl53l0x.pdf (pp. 1, 21–24). Single-zone ranging gives one distance per reading over I2C. The 940 nm emitter is infrared. Up to 2 m is a conditional manufacturer specification, not verified prototype range. One reading cannot prove the full ramp area clear. Visible RYS1230 marking lasers are separate from the ToF sensor.

Q&A appendix. Outside the timed 5-minute core presentation.
Primary source: ../SG_GoAssist_Prototype_Action_Plan.pdf, p. 3. The original nine steps are request, recognise, prepare, dock, mark zone, check zone, deploy, board and complete. Current physical end-to-end completion has not been established. The camera interprets the scene and VL53L0X provides a single-zone range check in a limited monitored field. One range does not establish full-area clearance. Sensor specification: STMicroelectronics VL53L0X product page https://www.st.com/en/imaging-and-photonics-solutions/vl53l0x.html and DS11555 Rev 6 https://www.st.com/resource/en/datasheet/vl53l0x.pdf (pp. 1, 21–24). Single-zone ranging gives one distance per reading over I2C. The 940 nm emitter is infrared. Up to 2 m is a conditional manufacturer specification, not verified prototype range. One reading cannot prove the full ramp area clear. Visible RYS1230 marking lasers are separate from the ToF sensor.
